summary: Integrate five Luna-authored bitwise forms after fresh proof replay and source review; record the complete adaptive OpenRouter reviewer trial and update Stratic and coverage.

examined.reason: Three selected .b32 operations now implemented by the exact Luna patch; typed frontend and shared execution/existence proofs linked and independently replayed.
not.b32 and cnot.b32 now implemented by Luna after two recorded proof repairs; no coordinator edits to candidate code, with exact input/target and error-classification checks.
Ledger now records fourteen accepted forms, five new source-section hashes, replay/patch evidence, and explicitly missing legal siblings; no full-section coverage claim.
Remaining-work metadata recognizes new selected forms and separate review evidence; generating and reviewing models do not replace coordinator source acceptance.
Reference enums and explicit schema improve inspectability; all 38 adaptive invocations retain failures, unknown cost and independent finding adjudication, without promoting agreement to fidelity.
Only sixty new independent leaf declarations were appended to the shared audit; existing message-passing semantics and theorem dependency entries are unchanged and pass again.
Both leaves instantiate the existing total Pure32 interface; generic state, guard, read ordering, target check and transition rules are byte-for-byte unchanged.
Source judgment, checked proofs and model opinions remain separate; raw vendor-bearing responses are local, public evidence contains authored adjudications and hashes.
Existing Codex headless isolation, recorded repair, exact patch and fresh replay mechanisms were reused without change.
The source-section inventory stays not_assessed; five explicit accepted forms extend its separate ledger without converting an entire section to covered or claiming an ISA percentage.

results.method: bash scripts/check.sh; bash integration/torchlean/check.sh; stratic validate; exact historical runner/packet reconstruction; retained-evidence hash checks; public-text/archive quotation scan and git diff --check
results.environment: Pinned root Lean toolchain and pinned TorchLean integration dependencies on Linux; Python standard-library tests. Integration Lean/configuration inputs unchanged throughout the final root and description checks.
results.evidence: Root: 14 accepted forms, 837 files in 8 evidence archives, 7 inventory tests, 102 worker tests, 26 ledger tests, 1273 declaration dependency audit; integration: 363 exact dependency reports. All passed with only standard Lean axioms, no proof placeholders or new unchecked axioms. Four reviewer runner versions and seven complete frozen packets reconstruct exactly; 42 retained mechanical evidence files match their hashes. Every one of 38 model calls is adjudicated including failures, wrong counterexample and unknown cost. Public text/archive scan found no 24-word windows copied from manual paragraphs; this heuristic is not a general copyright audit. Stratic structure/links and patch formatting pass. Before/after root-check snapshots match.
